facts.text: Jolene owns a pet snake named Susie, which she described as calming and happy-making.

evidence.quote: I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.

facts.text: Jolene owns a second pet snake named Seraphim, which she described as having sly eyes.

evidence.quote: My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!

facts.text: Jolene shared a fun moment with her pet snake Seraphim, where it slinked out of its cage and coiled up next to her while she was playing video games.

evidence.quote: I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it.
